zh: 大阪大学（Osaka University）成立于1931年，位于日本大阪府吹田市，是日本顶尖的公立研究型大学，也是日本旧帝国大学之一。学校在医学、工程、自然科学、社会科学、人文艺术等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。大阪大学以其优秀的教学质量和丰富的学术资源，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Osaka University, founded in 1931, is a leading public research university in Suita, Osaka, Japan, and one of Japan's former imperial universities. It excels in medicine, engineering, natural sciences, social sciences, humanities, and more, with world-leading academic research. Known for its excellent teaching quality and rich academic resources, Osaka University has produced numerous talents across fields.
